title: Serve the assignment ledger as one server row: stage, submissions, stall
deviations_from_card: (1) listCaseLedger/listCaseLedgerFacets live in a NEW store slice app/_lib/db/devcase-ledger.ts instead of app/_lib/db/devcase.ts: putting ~8 KB into devcase.ts pushed four more studio routes (devcase/control, session/[id]/submit, analyze, hire-from-need) over their perf-budget.json ceilings; the slice is imported only by GET /api/devcase, so devcase.ts is unchanged vs base. Because devcase-tenancy.test.ts scans only devcase.ts, devcase-ledger.test.ts carries a STRICTER per-alias tenant guard for the slice (every dev_cases/dev_lifecycle/dev_postings alias must have its own alias.workspace_id = ?) plus a non-vacuity case. (2) Added a coded refusal DEVCASE_CASE_NOT_FOUND to REFUSAL_ERRORS (app/_lib/api-response.ts, appended at the end under the lock) + errors.* in 4 catalogs, and corrected devcase.casesTable.noMatches ('No loaded assignments...' -> 'No assignments...') in 4 locales since the filter is now a library-wide query. (3) GET /api/devcase also returns `facets` {stages, seniorities} for the whole workspace, so the pickers do not collapse to the chosen value once the page is the filtered answer. (4) The [id] 404 test lives in a colocated app/api/devcase/[id]/route.test.ts (needs the session-cookie harness), not in route.test.ts. (5) DevCasesTable.filter.ts keeps CaseFilters + EMPTY_CASE_FILTERS + caseFiltersActive; caseStage/filterCases are removed. Index is created in-store (ledgerStore, submissionStore shape), not in core.ts.
notes: Response shape change of GET /api/devcase: rows are CaseLedgerRow (no need/analysis/role/case/scenario/seed; adds stage, submissionCount, lifecycleId, lifecycleCreatedAt/UpdatedAt, jdSlug, jobId/jobTitle) plus `facets`; only consumer is useDevTabData. For devcase-workspace/B (next wave): filterCases/caseStage no longer exist - a ?job= filter should be added as a store/URL param (listCaseLedger filters + filterCasesUrl), and ?case= should open via selectedCaseId (the detail reads GET /api/devcase/[id], so a case past the page needs no raiseLimit). The detail reader refetches when the ledger reloads (casesState.lastUpdated) and shows a LoadingGap (loading-gap-debt ratchet) while fetching. test:perf: red only on lines not attributable to this card - job-ingest.ts 402/400 (known) and app/api/devcase/lifecycle/[id]/approve/route.ts 3033/3032 KB, measured at 3105926 B with sibling UNCOMMITTED app/_lib/db/profiles.ts + analyses.ts on its graph; this card's only contribution to that graph is the ~240 B REFUSAL_ERRORS line, and without it the route still rounds to 3033. The ledger slice is on no other route's graph. tsc: clean except the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (pre-existing, not tracked). Full test:unit 9824/9824 green. New slice app/_lib/db/devcase-ledger.ts is not covered by scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json (maps app/_lib/db/devcase.ts only) - a one-glob addition for the coordinator if wanted. First red run of [id]/route.test.ts used an unescaped [id] glob (0 tests); the route file did not exist at that point, so the file was red by construction (re-run with [[]id] after the build: 3/3).
